fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (35.367588,-119.07772) were ~25 km off, landing on an oil tank farm. Resolved the real Kern Plant via web search (CLUI, PotatoPro, TruckMap) to 28801 Hwy 58, Bakersfield CA 93314 — an isolated industrial complex NW of Bakersfield surrounded by pivot-irrigated farmland. Locked center at 35.39575,-119.32045.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck entrance: a wide paved driveway off the north public road (Hwy 58 / Rosedale Hwy frontage) that crosses a BNSF rail spur and curves into the property. Street View (captured 2026-04) shows a continuous chain-link perimeter fence with a single driveway gap, orange lane delineators in the drive, and a small structure beside the lane. A LEED-Gold flagship food-manufacturing plant of this scale on an isolated site is gated as a matter of course.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure sits beside the entrance driveway near the rail crossing with vehicles parked around it, consistent with a guard booth. Imagery resolution at the entrance is limited (heavy tree shadow on satellite, booth at edge of Street View range) so this is medium-confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The entrance driveway is wide with a large open paved apron inside the rail crossing — ample unused width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along the south/southeast face of the main building where trailers are backed in; exact count not crisply resolvable from overhead — estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard south of the main building holds many rows of parked trailers (90+ counted in z19 imagery), clearly a 50+ band trailer-storage yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: BNSF rail spur runs along the north edge of the property; Street View shows covered-hopper rail cars parked on the spur (bulk grain/corn inbound).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Driveway crosses the rail then opens onto a deep paved apron that can stack 3+ trucks before reaching the docks.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the active fenced developed footprint (~110 acres). The full Kern Plant land holding is ~640 acres (one square mile) of mostly undeveloped farmland; the audited yard is the developed core.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in imagery; left false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved apron inside the gate before the docks provides holding room; inferred from layout.
